hf_gate.notes: AEON-7 abliteration of Qwen3.8-27B (BF16, uncensored). Same hybrid Gated DeltaNet (GDN) VLM architecture: 48 linear-attention + 16 full-attention layers. BF16 full precision (~52GB). In-checkpoint MTP head (EAGLE 3/1/4). Vision tower unmodified. Served via SGLang (lmsysorg/sglang:qwen38-27b, flashinfer 0.6.18) on DGX Spark port 30000. Thinking ON by default; vision requires thinking on.
